howto.name: Upload the host PDF
howto.text: Drop the PDF you want to embed a file inside (up to 500 MB).

howto.name: Add the file to attach
howto.text: Drop any file up to 50 MB — image, spreadsheet, .zip, even another PDF. PrivaTools embeds it without altering the visible content.

howto.name: Download the result
howto.text: Click Attach. The output PDF has your file embedded as an attachment; readers like Acrobat show it in the Attachments panel.

faq.q: What's the difference between an attachment and embedding?
faq.a: An attachment is a file stored inside the PDF that the reader can open separately. Embedding means inlining content (images, fonts) into the page itself. Use attachments when you want recipients to access the supporting file but keep the visible PDF clean.

faq.q: Can I attach more than one file?
faq.a: Yes, one per run: run the tool again on the result to add the next file. Earlier attachments stay in place.

faq.q: How big can the embedded file be?
faq.a: Up to 50 MB, and the PDF and the attachment together must fit within one 500 MB upload. The attachment is stored compressed, so the PDF grows by about its size, or much less for text-like files that compress well.
